tasks.title: Create internal/engine with the Run type, NewRun, Background and Invalidate
steps: Create the directory internal/engine/ and a file engine.go.
Define the BranchInfo struct with fields Base, Work, MergeBase string and Existed bool.

Define the Run struct with fields Root string, Git *gitx.Git, Lang lang.Detection, Branch BranchInfo, Ledger *Ledger, Gate *GateCache, Index tools.Index, Scratch string, Progress toolio.Progress, Record *toolio.Run.

Implement NewRun(root string, git *gitx.Git, opts RunOptions, det lang.Detection) (*Run, error): resolve symlinks on root, verify git.IsRepo, create a new Ledger and GateCache, populate the Run, and return it. Return nil + error if not a repo.
Define RunOptions struct with fields Index tools.Index, Scratch string, Progress toolio.Progress, Record *toolio.Run.
Implement Background(ctx context.Context) (context.Context, context.CancelFunc) returning context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 2*time.Minute).
Implement Invalidate(run *Run): if run.Index != nil, call run.Index.Invalidate("").
Define PreflightOpts struct with fields Land string, DryRun bool, NeedsPush bool, NeedsForge bool, Forge issuex.Client.

Implement CommonPreflight(ctx context.Context, run *Run, opts PreflightOpts) error: check IsRepo, DirtyFiles, base branch not empty (not detached), base branch not matching fix/* or impl/*, remote existence when NeedsPush, forge auth when NeedsForge. Return error on first failure.
Write TS-20-1, TS-20-2, TS-20-27, TS-20-28, TS-20-29, TS-20-30 in internal/engine/engine_test.go using real temp git repos (gitx.New on t.TempDir()). Confirm all pass.
Run `go test ./internal/engine/... -count=1` and `make lint`.

tasks.title: Implement the Ledger: snapshot, owned/protected/foreign paths, OwnChange, commit and change classification
steps: Create internal/engine/ledger.go with the Ledger struct: fields snapshot map[string]bool, owned []string, protected []string, foreignPath func(string) bool, leftWarned map[string]bool, and a reference to the run recorder.
Define the Change struct with Path, Status, Kind string.
Implement NewLedger(record *toolio.Run) *Ledger.
Implement Ledger.Snapshot(ctx context.Context, git *gitx.Git): call git.UntrackedFiles, build the map; on error set snapshot to nil.
Implement Ledger.SetOwned(paths ...string), Ledger.SetProtected(paths ...string), Ledger.SetForeignPath(fn func(string) bool).

Implement Ledger.Changes(ctx context.Context, git *gitx.Git, since string) ([]Change, error): call git.DiffSince for name-status, parse each line, add untracked files not in snapshot as status '?', classify each path's Kind using the classifiers from task 3 (IsTestFile, GateConfigFile, GoldenFile) plus project.IsDocsFile, scratch prefix, and protected prefix checks.

Implement Ledger.Commit(ctx context.Context, git *gitx.Git, message string, noVerify bool, reported []FileChange) (string, error): call git.UntrackedFiles, separate into leave (in snapshot or foreignPath) and unlisted (not in reported), warn with WarnUntrackedFilesLeftAlone and WarnUnlistedFileCommitted, call git.CommitAllExcept.
Implement Ledger.OwnChange(ctx context.Context, git *gitx.Git) bool: call git.ChangedFiles or git.UntrackedFiles, return true if any file is not in the snapshot.
Implement Ledger.FlagGateEdits(ctx context.Context, git *gitx.Git, since string, run *toolio.Run): call git.DiffSince, run GateEdits (from task 3), warn via run.Warn with WarnGateEdited.
Define FileChange struct (Path, Status string) in the engine package for the reported parameter.
Write TS-20-3 through TS-20-9 in internal/engine/ledger_test.go using real temp git repos. Confirm all pass.
Run `go test ./internal/engine/... -count=1` and `make lint`.

tasks.title: Implement the GateCache with tree-hash computation, RunGate, and export GateResult/compareGate/landable
steps: Create internal/engine/gate.go with the GateCache struct: a map keyed by (treeHash+command) string to checks.Result.
Implement NewGateCache() *GateCache.

Implement treeHash(ctx context.Context, git *gitx.Git) (string, error): try `git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}` first; if the tree is dirty (git.DirtyFiles returns non-empty), stage all via git.StageAllExcept(nil), run `git write-tree` via the runner, then unstage. Combine with sorted untracked files for the final key.

Implement GateCache.Run(ctx context.Context, runner gitx.Runner, git *gitx.Git, root, command string, timeout time.Duration, label string, record *toolio.Run) checks.Result: compute treeHash, look up cache, on hit return cached result and record timing with cached:true, on miss call checks.Run, store, return. On treeHash error, fall through to uncached run.

Implement GateCache.RunGate(ctx context.Context, runner gitx.Runner, git *gitx.Git, root string, commands []string, timeout time.Duration, label string, progress toolio.Progress, record *toolio.Run) GateResult: iterate commands, call GateCache.Run for each, collect into GateResult.
Move GateResult type from codeimpl/types.go to internal/engine/gate.go with its methods: Ran, OK, CouldNotRun (exported), Aborted (exported), Failing (exported).
Move compareGate and landable from codeimpl/gate.go to internal/engine/gate.go, exporting them as CompareGate and Landable.
Move VerdictGateFailed and VerdictBaselineRepaired constants to internal/engine/gate.go.
Write TS-20-10 through TS-20-15 in internal/engine/gate_test.go. Confirm all pass.
Run `go test ./internal/engine/... -count=1` and `make lint`.

tasks.title: Implement branching: SetupBranch and ResumeBranch
steps: Create internal/engine/branch.go.

Implement SetupBranch(ctx context.Context, run *Run, prefix string, number int, title string) error: call git.BaseBranch to capture base; if base is empty, return error mentioning detached HEAD; if base matches fix/* or impl/*, return error naming the work-branch pattern; compute branch name via gitx.BranchName and gitx.UniqueBranchName; call git.CreateBranch; record base, work, merge-base on run.Branch; call Invalidate.

Implement ResumeBranch(ctx context.Context, run *Run, branch string) error: call git.Checkout on the branch; detect parked wip: commits via git.HeadMessage; if parked, reset hard to HEAD~1 and clean; record branch info on run.Branch.
Write TS-20-20, TS-20-21, TS-20-22, TS-20-23 in internal/engine/branch_test.go using real temp git repos. Confirm all pass.
Run `go test ./internal/engine/... -count=1` and `make lint`.

tasks.title: Implement Park, ReturnCheckout, Push and OpenPullRequest
steps: Create internal/engine/park.go.

Implement Park(ctx context.Context, run *Run, message string, reported []FileChange) (string, error): create background context via Background(ctx); check run.Ledger.OwnChange; if yes, commit via run.Ledger.Commit with noVerify=true; on commit error, warn WarnCommitNotParked; checkout base branch via run.Git.Checkout; on checkout error, warn WarnCheckoutNotRestored; never return a non-nil error.
Implement ReturnCheckout(ctx context.Context, run *Run): create background context; checkout run.Branch.Base; on error warn WarnCheckoutNotRestored.
Create internal/engine/push.go.
Implement Push(ctx context.Context, run *Run, attempts int) error: call run.Git.Push with the work branch, attempts, and a progress log function; record the side effect on run.Record.
Create internal/engine/pr.go.

Implement OpenPullRequest(ctx context.Context, run *Run, forge issuex.Client, target issuex.Repo, req issuex.CreatePullRequestRequest) (string, error): compute maxLen via issuex.MaxBodyLength(forge); if len(req.Body) > maxLen, truncate req.Body to maxLen; call forge.CreatePullRequest; return the PR URL.
Write TS-20-16 through TS-20-19 in internal/engine/park_test.go, TS-20-31 in internal/engine/push_test.go, and TS-20-32 and TS-20-33 in internal/engine/pr_test.go. Confirm all pass.
Run `go test ./internal/engine/... -count=1` and `make lint`.
